counter_consistency.detail: counter 271.295 J vs integrated power 281.785 J: 3.7% apart, within tolerance 140.892 J
counter_consistency.method: cumulative counter vs trapezoidal integral of sampled power

gpu_counter_resolution.detail: events shorter than the update interval quantize to 0 or one whole step and are not measurable by counter differencing

boundary.detail: measured_energy_j will be null on this host; missing: cpu_package, dram

node_telemetry.detail: no IPMI/BMC/Redfish/hwmon power source found; no independent whole-node validation possible

notes: RAPL core and uncore are diagnostic only and are never added to measured_energy_j; core is contained within package.
psys is excluded because it is a platform domain that contains package.
A domain reported UNAVAILABLE must remain null downstream, never zero.
CodeCarbon is not independent validation: it reads NVML and RAPL itself.
An advancing GPU energy counter is cross-checked against the integral of sampled board power; a counter that disagrees grossly is reported INCONSISTENT and contributes no GPU energy to the boundary.
Sampled power is a diagnostic plausibility yardstick only. It is never reported as measured energy and never substituted for a counter.

gpu_counter_disturbance.method: paired windows: endpoints-only vs counter read at 10 Hz; identical endpoint reads
gpu_counter_disturbance.detail: reading the energy counter lowers the energy it reports on this host; GPU energy measured with the sampler running or with frequent span reads is biased low here
